use: Turning aggregate public records into identifiable leads

use: Ranking or scoring ISED estimates coded F
rationale: Source: not reliable, do not use

use: Using ISED estimates coded E
rationale: Permitted only with an explicit caution flag and a sensitivity check

use: ISED 2023 context shown alongside 1097 December 2025 scale
rationale: Permitted only with both periods labelled

use: Summing overlapping tourism or special-industry aggregates
rationale: Aggregates overlap sectors (source footnotes)

use: Joining geography records by names alone

use: Joining shared CMA codes across 2016 and 2021 vintages without qualification
rationale: Codes match but boundaries may differ

use: 0722 active enterprises and 1097 locations shown side by side for one CMA

use: Summing 0722 industries or CMAs to build a total
rationale: Enterprises counted in each industry/region (Note 2)

use: Building provincial totals by summing 1097 CSDs

use: Zero-filling 0722 'x'/'..', ISED '..' or out-of-scope 1097 geographies

use: Using 1097 as a time series
